note: The sidebar tree. `order` is display order; `icon` names a glyph in icons.js. Nested two levels because the tree IS two levels. A category may have NO subcategories at all -- Bedcovers & Quilts and Table Runners both hold products directly, and such a product carries no `sub` key. sidebar.js must render a zero-child AND a one-child group as a plain link, never as a disclosure: an expand arrow that reveals one row (or none) reads as a broken menu.
